description: Declares one call signature for checkers; the stubs are registered for `typing.get_overloads`, and only the final undecorated function runs.
A checker refining a value's type inside a branch after `isinstance`, `is None`, a `match` case or a type guard.
Return type of a predicate that narrows to `T` when true and to not-`T` when false (PEP 742, Python 3.13).
Marks code that is unreachable when every variant is handled; a checker errors on a missing branch and the call raises `AssertionError` at runtime.
Returns its argument unchanged; it only tells the checker to trust a type, like TypeScript's `as`.
